evidence.evidenceSnippet: Uppsala University's student AI-tool page says students have free access to Copilot, and that when students log in with their student account, their interactions are covered by the university's Microsoft data-protection agreement, chat data is not saved, and data is not used to train Copilot's large language models.
Students at Uppsala University have free access to the AI tool Copilot.
When you log in with your student account, using Copilot is as safe as using other Microsoft online services (M365).
When you log in, your interactions with Copilot are safeguarded through the university’s agreement for data protection with Microsoft ...
Students have free Copilot access; when logged in with a student account, Copilot interactions are covered by Uppsala's Microsoft data-protection agreement and are not used to train LLMs.

description: University-licensed Microsoft Copilot browser chat with institutional data protection.
howToObtain: Log in to Copilot in a browser using the University student account or staff account.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Uppsala University says Copilot is available in browser form for all students and staff, and students have free access using their University account. The University's Copilot license is covered by its Microsoft data-protection agreement, and a conversation is limited to 30 responses.
